narr: Deep monsoon moisture over northern Arizona lead to the development of thunderstorms with heavy rain and flash flooding. A flash flood watch was issued for parts of northern Arizona during the late morning through late evening.
ev: A flash flood was reported on Highway 89 about 8 miles northeast of Doney Park (mile post 430...north of Wupatki Trails and south of the Sunset Crater turnoff). The highway was closed in both directions. Flooding also overtopped the highway at Brandis Way.
lsr: CORRECTS PREVIOUS FLASH FLOOD REPORT FROM 8 NNW DONEY PARK. HIGHWAY 89 WAS CLOSED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS (NORTH/SOUTH) AS WATER OVERTOP THE HIGHWAY AT MILEPOST 430 NORTH OF WUPATKI TRAILS/SOUTH OF SUNSET
FLOWS FROM RAIN HAVE BEEN REPORTED OVERTOPPING HIGHWAY 89 AT BRANDIS WAY.
